answer: The fee is charged through a raven debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the echo totals, and the jade anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 6 units per epoch, sustaining 79 aliases for 19 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. Slashing removes 91 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
